description: What each class of perturbation claim may reach, and what it must have to get there. This table is the pack's central artifact: it exists to stop two opposite errors — upgrading a cell-level association into a population claim, and rejecting a legitimately narrow within-screen result because it lacks donors it never needed. A claim is classified first; the ceiling follows from the class, not from how convincing the write-up is.
source: Distilled from the perturbation positive-case matrix and the hard denominator rules. Both directions matter: the rules demote, the matrix protects.

classes.label: Realized-screen cell-level association
classes.minimum_units: cells whose exchangeability is defended explicitly
classes.common_failure: batch, cell-state, or sequencing-depth confounding read as biology
conditions_that_must_be_stated: the exchangeability of cells within this screen, defended rather than assumed
that no population-level reading is intended or supported

classes.label: Guide-conditioned within-screen perturbation contrast
classes.minimum_units: cells plus guide assignment and matched controls
classes.denominator: guide/cell model, scope bounded by the screen
classes.common_failure: guide capture, off-target activity, or weak controls
conditions_that_must_be_stated: that the scope is the screen this was measured in, not the population

classes.label: Target-conditioned perturbation effect
classes.minimum_units: multiple independent guides per target plus efficacy and QC
classes.denominator: guide/target model, scope bounded by the screen
classes.common_failure: guide redundancy mistaken for biological replication
conditions_that_must_be_stated: that the scope is the screen this was measured in, not the population

classes.label: Donor-replicated population claim
classes.minimum_units: donors crossed with perturbation and context
classes.denominator: donor-level pseudobulk, or a mixed/cluster-robust model
classes.common_failure: too few donors, or donor confounded with condition
classes.few_cluster_condition: with fewer than the warning threshold of upstream units, cluster-robust uncertainty is unreliable; the report carries an explicit few-cluster caveat
conditions_that_must_be_stated: that the claim rests on the independence of its upstream units, which the data cannot verify and the design has to argue
that the analysis was carried out at the estimand-matching denominator, naming it

classes.label: Animal or in vivo claim
classes.minimum_units: animals or experiments crossed with perturbation
classes.common_failure: cells nested inside an animal counted as animals
classes.few_cluster_condition: with fewer than the warning threshold of upstream units, cluster-robust uncertainty is unreliable; the report carries an explicit few-cluster caveat
conditions_that_must_be_stated: that the claim rests on the independence of its upstream units, which the data cannot verify and the design has to argue
that the analysis was carried out at the estimand-matching denominator, naming it

classes.label: Organoid or patient-model claim
classes.minimum_units: patient, organoid, or model-system units crossed with perturbation
classes.common_failure: generalizing from the model system to the organism it stands in for
classes.few_cluster_condition: with fewer than the warning threshold of upstream units, cluster-robust uncertainty is unreliable; the report carries an explicit few-cluster caveat
conditions_that_must_be_stated: that the claim rests on the independence of its upstream units, which the data cannot verify and the design has to argue
that the analysis was carried out at the estimand-matching denominator, naming it

classes.label: Spatial or tissue perturbation claim
classes.minimum_units: tissue sections, animals, or experiments, plus spatial units
classes.common_failure: spatial spots or cells treated as independent animals
conditions_that_must_be_stated: the spatial autocorrelation structure and how it was accounted for
that spots and cells are not being counted as independent tissue units
that the claim rests on the independence of its upstream units, which the data cannot verify and the design has to argue
that the analysis was carried out at the estimand-matching denominator, naming it

classes.label: Network or causal-method claim
classes.minimum_units: a perturbation design plus stated identifying assumptions
classes.denominator: the unit the assumptions actually license
classes.common_failure: identifiability hidden inside the model rather than argued
conditions_that_must_be_stated: the sensitivity of the conclusion to each assumption being wrong

classes.label: Model M predicts the response better than baseline B
classes.minimum_units: a held-out split whose axis matches the generalization claimed
classes.denominator: the evaluation unit named in the split policy
classes.common_failure: beating a weak baseline, or winning one metric by sacrificing another

classes.label: Support drawn from published sources without an executable check
classes.common_failure: a well-sourced summary presented as an audit
conditions_that_must_be_stated: that nothing was computed and no data were examined

hard_rejections.when: a population-level claim whose only replicate evidence is cell count
hard_rejections.why: cells inside one donor, animal, or screen are not independent draws from the population the claim is about. More cells shrink the standard error of the wrong estimand.

hard_rejections.when: lanes, captures, libraries, or sequencing batches promoted to biological replicates without a design ledger
hard_rejections.why: a technical process unit shares the biology it was split from; replicating the process is not replicating the biology.

hard_rejections.when: multiple-testing correction offered as the answer to clustered cell-level uncertainty
hard_rejections.why: the correction controls the false-discovery rate across features. It does not change the denominator, and the denominator is what is wrong.

hard_rejections.when: multiple guides used in place of donor, animal, or screen replication for a population claim
hard_rejections.why: several guides against one target in one screen test the perturbation, not the population.

hard_rejections.when: a generalization claim whose test perturbations, cell lines, or donors appear in training
hard_rejections.why: the held-out axis is the claim. If it leaks, the number measures memorization on exactly the axis being claimed.

hard_rejections.when: a predictive-superiority claim whose model does not beat the strongest simple baseline
hard_rejections.why: the burden of proof is on the model. Losing to a control mean or an additive baseline refutes the claim as stated.

ceiling_note: A note about the word CONDITIONAL, because two vocabularies collide here and the collision is easy to get backwards. In the positive-case matrix this pack was distilled from, 'conditional' meant a narrow result resting on an assumption nobody can discharge, and it was WEAKER than a bounded result. In the frame's lattice CONDITIONAL is STRONGER than CHECKED_BOUNDED, because it is a claim about the general statement modulo an assumption, while CHECKED_BOUNDED is a claim about a stated finite domain and silent outside it. The frame's reading is the correct one for these classes: a cell-level association is bounded, not conditionally-general. So every class here caps at CHECKED_BOUNDED, and what used to be expressed as a lower ceiling is expressed instead as an EXTRA obligation — `conditions_that_must_be_stated` — which is strictly harder to satisfy than a ceiling, because a ceiling can be met by doing nothing.
crossing_note: Crossing is required of a BIOLOGICAL unit and is meaningless for an ASSIGNMENT unit. A donor could have contributed cells under both conditions, so a donor that saw only one condition is confounded with it. A guide could not: a guide is targeting or non-targeting by construction, and demanding that it be crossed would reject every screen ever run. So the confounding check applies to population estimands, and within-screen estimands are held to a different bar — several independent units per arm, matched controls, and demonstrated perturbation efficacy.
conditions_note: Population classes carry required report conditions, added after an external evaluation against a regression family written for the predecessor system. Its expectations attached `upstream_units_required` and `pseudobulk_or_cluster_robust_required` as flags a report must SHOW, where this table had them only as design evidence a bundle must DECLARE. Both are checks and they are not the same check: a reader of the finished report sees the second and not the first, and the independence of the upstream units is the assumption that reader most needs and the data can least support.
selection_note: Each class carries the terms that route a statement to it, scored the way the frame resolves packs: 1 x signals + 3 x strong_signals - 3 x excludes, against the class's own min_score, with a margin over the runner-up. The terms live here rather than in the classifier, so the field knowledge stays in the pack's data and the scorer stays generic. scripts/classify_claim.py reads this and nothing else.
